summary: The diff implements responsive layout changes in GameBoard.tsx, NextPiecePreview.tsx, GameCanvas.tsx, TouchControlButtons.tsx, and index.css. REQ-13 (Next Pieces panel above game board on mobile) and REQ-14 (fully responsive game screen layout) appear to be substantially addressed. The implementation includes a dynamic cell size hook, horizontal layout mode for NextPiecePreview, viewport-relative sizing, and overflow prevention in CSS.
